goal: Determinar la magnitud y persistencia de la marca H3K27ac depositada por dCas9-p300, y cuanto dura la activacion transcripcional una vez retirado el editor (reversibilidad y control temporal).

questions.question: According to these sources, what magnitude of H3K27ac enrichment (relative to baseline) does dCas9-p300 deposit at targeted loci, and by which method (e.g., ChIP-seq, ChIP-qPCR) was it measured?
How far does the H3K27ac deposited by dCas9-p300 spread from the targeted site, according to these sources?

According to these sources, once the dCas9-p300 effector is withdrawn or inactivated (e.g., via inducible/degron systems), how long does the induced gene activation persist before returning to baseline?
What systems (e.g., drug-inducible, degron, optogenetic) have been used in these sources to achieve temporal control of dCas9-p300 activity, and how precisely can activation be turned on and off?

According to these sources, does the H3K27ac mark itself decay at the same rate as the transcriptional activation once dCas9-p300 is removed, or can epigenetic memory persist after expression returns to baseline?
What gaps or limitations remain in these sources regarding quantitative kinetics of H3K27ac persistence and decay after dCas9-p300 withdrawal?
